## Discovery & Translational Science

- **AI-designed PROTAC targets CLIP1-LTK fusion in resistant cancers** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42561017/)
  - An AI-driven PROTAC design successfully eliminated the CLIP1-LTK fusion protein, overcoming oncogenic resistance mechanisms in preclinical models.

- **Novel oral benzimidazole-based STING antagonists demonstrate in vivo efficacy** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42562155/)
  - Researchers identified orally bioavailable benzimidazole small-molecule STING antagonists that exhibit potent in vivo anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory activity.

- **Glomerular-targeted liposomal prednisolone treats lupus nephritis in mice** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.01.742194)
  - Collagen IV α3-targeted prednisolone-loaded nanoparticles (Col4-3-Pred-NPs) delivered low-dose corticosteroids directly to glomeruli in MRL/lpr mice, improving survival and reducing proteinuria without systemic glucocorticoid toxicity.

- **Study unveils novel structural role for tau in neurodegeneration** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/06/research-finds-how-tau-targets-cells-structure-alzheimers-drug-development/)
  - A translational study describes a previously unknown role for tau protein in maintaining and altering cellular structural integrity, offering new target biology for Alzheimer's drug discovery.

- **Phosphorylation-independent antibody enhances TDP-43 pathology detection** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42562773/)
  - A novel monoclonal antibody binding TDP-43 independently of phosphorylation status improved neuropathological detection across frontotemporal lobar degeneration, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and limbic-predominant age-related TDP-43 encephalopathy (LATE).

- **GLP-1 receptor agonist resistance linked to distinct hepatic mitochondrial phenotype** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.04.26359613)
  - Molecular profiling of GLP-1 refractory obesity (<5% weight loss at 12 months) revealed specific hepatic mitochondrial and ultrastructural alterations that correlated with blunted post-bariatric surgery weight loss.

- **Blood-to-tissue TMB ratio identified as prognostic biomarker in advanced NSCLC** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.04.26359280)
  - A high blood-to-tissue tumor mutational burden ratio (bTMB/tTMB) independently predicted significantly worse overall survival (median 11 vs. 33 months; HR 0.55, p = 0.04) in patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors.

---

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

- **Cannabis extract NTI164 improves core symptoms in Phase 2 autism trial** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42561512/)
  - Results from the double-blind, randomized controlled Harmony trial showed that NTI164, a full-spectrum medicinal cannabis extract formulation, significantly improved core behavioral symptoms in pediatric patients with autism spectrum disorder.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Amgen clarifies clinical hold status for Imdelltra combination trial** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2085368388981768204)
  - Amgen clarified that the Dellphi-310 study evaluating Imdelltra (tarlatamab) in combination with tambota-P was placed on a clinical hold following a fatal pneumonitis event, refuting reports that the trial had been permanently discontinued.

---

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

- **[Biotech]** **Tenax Therapeutics approaches key Phase 3 readout in heart failure** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/06/tenax-study-heart-failure-preview/)
  - Tenax is finalizing a pivotal Phase 3 trial evaluating its lead candidate for heart failure, marking a key upcoming clinical efficacy readout for the company.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Tezepelumab shows rapid and sustained real-world asthma control in ASCENT trial** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42562237/)
  - Initial 24-week results from the real-world ASCENT study demonstrated early and continuous symptom control with tezepelumab (Amgen/AstraZeneca) in patients with severe, uncontrolled asthma.

- **Meta-analysis confirms PCSK9 inhibitor efficacy in pediatric heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.04.26359681)
  - A systematic review of Phase 3 randomized controlled trials evaluating evolocumab, alirocumab, and inclisiran in children and adolescents (<18 years) with HeFH demonstrated a mean LDL-C reduction of 35.44% (95% CI: -41.74 to -29.14) when added to baseline lipid-lowering therapy.

---

## Regulatory & Approvals

- **[Biotech]** **FDA grants accelerated approval to Replimune’s oncolytic virus Tudriqev for advanced melanoma** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/replimune-tudriqev-fda-approve-melanoma-rp1/827226/)
  - The FDA granted accelerated approval to Tudriqev (vusolimogene oderparepvec-wtpg), an intratumorally injected oncolytic immunotherapy, combined with BMS’s Opdivo (nivolumab) for adult patients with unresectable advanced cutaneous melanoma progressing on prior anti-PD-1 therapy.
  - Approval was supported by a single-arm trial showing a 25% objective response rate with a median response duration of nearly 14 months; full approval remains contingent on an ongoing Phase 3 confirmatory trial expected in late 2027.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Takeda wins FDA approval for first-in-class orexin-2 agonist Orzeyful in narcolepsy** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/takeda-fda-sleep-drug-approval-orexin-orzeyful-narcolepsy/827190/)
  - The FDA cleared Orzeyful (TAK-861), an oral orexin-2 receptor agonist, for Type 1 narcolepsy, marking the first regulatory approval for this target class.
  - Clinical trials demonstrated significant efficacy in maintaining wakefulness and reducing cataplexy attacks compared to placebo.

- **[Biotech]** **FDA approves Moderna’s mRNA seasonal flu vaccine mFlusiva** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/moderna-fda-approve-mflusiva-seasonal-influenza/826864/)
  - The FDA approved mFlusiva (mRNA-1010), making it the first mRNA-based seasonal influenza vaccine cleared for adults aged 50 and older.
  - Clearance for adults ≥65 years was granted under accelerated approval, requiring a postmarketing efficacy trial across two flu seasons.

- **FDA approves first dual BAFF and APRIL inhibitor** [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00133-2)
  - Regulatory approval was granted for the first biologic dual inhibitor targeting both B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and a proliferation-inducing ligand (APRIL).

- **FDA issues updated guidance on nitrosamine limits and labeling standards** [FDA Guidance](http://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/cder-nitrosamine-impurity-acceptable-intake-limits)
  - CDER released updated Acceptable Intake (AI) limits for Nitrosamine Drug Substance-Related Impurities (NDSRIs) using the Carcinogenic Potency Categorization Approach (CPCA) and compound-specific safety data.
  - FDA scheduled upcoming regulatory workshops on communicating drug interactions and QTc prolongation risks in U.S. Prescribing Information.

---

## Business & Strategy

- **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly commits $2.8B to expand psychedelic psychiatric pipeline** [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00134-1)
  - Eli Lilly entered into strategic licensing agreements totalizing up to $2.8 billion to develop novel psychedelic-inspired compounds for neuropsychiatric disorders.

- **[Biotech]** **Tarsus acquires Stargardt startup Alkeus Pharmaceuticals for up to $800M** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/alkeus-tarsus-acquire-stargardt-drug-startup-boger/827243/)
  - Tarsus Pharmaceuticals agreed to acquire Alkeus for $270 million in upfront cash and $180 million in stock, plus up to $350 million in regulatory and commercial milestones.
  - The deal centers on gildeuretinol, an oral modified vitamin A candidate in development for Stargardt disease.

- **[Biotech]** **LifeMine Therapeutics raises $263M for fungal-derived immunosuppressant** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/lifemine-organ-transplant-rejection-drug-greg-verdine-financing/827145/)
  - LifeMine Therapeutics completed $263 million in venture financing to advance LIFE-001 into mid-to-late stage clinical testing for organ transplant rejection.
  - LIFE-001 is a fungal genomic-derived small molecule targeting calcineurin designed to prevent T-cell activation without the renal toxicity associated with tacrolimus and cyclosporine.

- **China cross-border licensing deals hit $153B YTD driven by rapid FIH trials** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/andrewpannu/status/2085366543295127653)
  - Out-licensing of Chinese biotech assets to Western pharma reached $153 billion across 95 deals year-to-date, driven by rapid Investigator-Initiated Trials (IITs) that generate fast clinical proof-of-concept in dense urban medical centers.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Medicare policy shift delays AbbVie price negotiations by seven years** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/08/06/medicare-gave-blockbuster-abbvie-drug-seven-extra-years-before-price-negotiations/)
  - A subtle administrative policy shift by CMS deferred Inflation Reduction Act price negotiation selection for a high-cost blockbuster drug from AbbVie by seven years.

---

## Public Health & Policy

- **Senate confirms Erica Schwartz as CDC Director** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/erica-schwartz-cdc-director-senate-confirm-vaccines-rfk/827188/)
  - The U.S. Senate confirmed public health official Erica Schwartz as Director of the CDC in a 51-44 vote, filling the vacancy following the removal of former director Susan Monarez.

- **U.S. moves to shut Kentucky organ procurement organization over safety failures** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/06/us-to-shut-kentucky-organ-donation-group-safety-concerns/)
  - Federal authorities initiated regulatory proceedings to shut down a Kentucky organ procurement group following reports of attempted organ retrieval from patients displaying signs of life.

- **Senate committee votes to hold Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/06/anthony-fauci-fifth-amendment-rand-paul-seeks-criminal-contempt/)
  - A Senate committee voted along party lines to cite former NIAID director Anthony Fauci for contempt of Congress after he declined to testify regarding COVID-19 pandemic response policies.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [I analyzed 1,000 Health Studies: Here are 10 Things I Learned](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sx8MyamJf3g) -- Physionic
        - Reviews findings across 1,000 health studies covering topics such as visceral fat, peptides, nutrient sensing, and resistant starches.
        - Evaluates specific peptide and therapeutic applications regarding osteoarthritis, liver health, and weight loss compounds like retatrutide.
        - Assesses nutritional science and supplementation data on omega-3s for muscle health, creatine for depression, and vitamin K2 / lycopene regarding liver cancer and vascular plaque reversal.
        - Highlights dietary impacts on cognitive and metabolic outcomes, including the roles of coffee, cheese, and the gut microbiome.
    - [Metabolic Vulnerability Index and mortality prediction | Jim Otvos, Ph.D.](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/7mXtpuO1XqI) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Explains why LDL particle number (LDL-P) provides a clearer assessment of cardiovascular risk than standard LDL cholesterol (LDL-C) concentration when the two markers diverge.
        - Challenges the concept that large, "fluffy" LDL particles are harmless, referencing genetic conditions that disprove the theory.
        - Details an NMR-derived score that identifies insulin resistance and predicts type 2 diabetes onset years before blood glucose levels rise.
        - Compares the NMR-based inflammatory marker GlycA to traditional hs-CRP testing, noting GlycA provides a more stable signal for chronic inflammation.
    - [AI Is Just a Tool, Not the Solution](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/apdWHmRex3Q) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Features George Mathew discussing the gap between artificial intelligence hype and actionable, real-world innovation.
        - Argues that AI serves strictly as an enabling tool rather than a comprehensive end-to-end solution.
        - Emphasizes that technological implementation alone cannot solve complex systemic problems without proper domain application.
    - [The Government Might Be Your Biggest Investor](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/nS5Lzlu9f1E) -- Health2Tech
        - Features Chris Moose detailing startup financing strategies involving government initiatives and public funding programs.
        - Identifies public sector funding as a potential major investment source for early-stage healthtech and tech companies.
        - Urges startup founders to actively track government funding channels for billion-dollar enterprise opportunities.
- Pure Science
    - [How do submarines know where they are?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/_1G8nrmBKeY) -- Veritasium
        - Explores how deep-sea submarines navigate accurately at depths reaching 600 meters where traditional GPS signals cannot penetrate.
        - Examines the operational tension between surfacing to verify geographic position and maintaining absolute stealth.
        - Introduces the technical strategies and tradeoffs involved in balancing underwater pathfinding with acoustic concealment.
- Other
    - [Earthquakes Explained: Crash Course Geology #14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WNvAic8KLb0) -- CrashCourse
        - Explores the fundamental geological causes of how and why earthquakes occur.
        - Details how seismic waves are used to measure earthquakes and assess associated risks.
        - Evaluates the feasibility of predicting earthquakes and examines strategies to protect against damaging shocks.
- To watch
    - [Cutting Moons  - Numberphile](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oYGBRhS1Ujo) -- Numberphile
